_comment: Visual curation pass, 2026-08-18. Every file in manifest.json was viewed on a contact sheet (build/contact-sheet-*.jpg) and given a verdict. The automated pipeline verifies licence, resolution, ratio, subject and country; it cannot tell a hero landscape from a seagull. This file is that judgement, recorded so it is reviewable and not repeated.

_verdicts.hero: Strong enough for a full-bleed hero band at 2400px.
_verdicts.gallery: Good at card or gallery scale; not at hero scale.
_verdicts.texture: Abstract/detail. Section backgrounds and accents, never a destination shot.

_focus_note: focus sets object-position on cropping slots. Landscapes with a low horizon or a subject under a lot of sky get their heads cut off by a default centre crop.

tongariro-01.note: Red Crater. The single best frame in the set - volcanic reds carry the whole palette argument.

tongariro-02.note: Ngauruhoe and Ruapehu, clear sky. The classic Crossing view.

tongariro-03.note: Moody cloud over forest and peaks.

tongariro-04.note: Ngauruhoe in cloud. Dark and atmospheric - sits beautifully on the basalt ground.

rotorua-03.note: Silica crust detail. Excellent abstract texture for section grounds.

rotorua-05.note: Pohutu geyser - good subject, but a burned-in camera date stamp (20.01.2017) in the corner. Unfixable without a crop that loses the plume.

waitomo-01.note: Photograph OF a printed archival page, not of the caves.

waitomo-03.note: Visitor centre architecture. The blocklist missed it - titled 'main entrance', not 'visitor centre'.

waitomo-04.note: Actual glowworm grotto - the money shot for Waitomo. Contains a family, but small and unlit; no identifiable faces. Use at gallery scale only, never enlarged.

waitomo-05.note: Ruakuri spiral ramp. Architectural, warm, genuinely distinctive.

coromandel-01.note: Te Hoho Rock through the Cathedral Cove arch. Iconic.

coromandel-02.note: Same subject, wider. Distant figures only - not identifiable.

coromandel-03.note: Red-billed gull on shingle. Passed every automated gate; it is a bird, not a destination.

coromandel-04.note: Hot Water Beach. Empty and flat, but honest.

bay-of-islands-01.note: Russell pier. Correct place - the geographic guard fixed this one.

bay-of-islands-03.note: Island arch with sailboat. Strong turquoise.

bay-of-islands-04.note: Rocks and beach. Best colour in the Northland set.

taupo-01.note: Huka Falls. That turquoise IS the lake token in the palette.

taupo-02.note: Lake Taupo under flat grey. Nothing happening in the frame.

taupo-03.note: Orakei Korako hot pool with steam.

taupo-05.note: 1887 sepia plate with a visible fold. Archival.

waiheke-01.note: Odd crop of a reflection pool. Reads as a mistake.

waiheke-02.note: Vineyard rows to the sea. The Waiheke shot.

waiheke-04.note: A 19th-century land sale deed. Document, not photograph.

waiheke-05.note: Blown-out sky, but the track through vines is usable small.

auckland-01.note: Lion Rock from North Piha. Black sand west coast - the basalt colour token, photographed.

auckland-02.note: Tree weta macro. Waitakere biodiversity categories leaked in.

east-cape-02.note: East Cape coastline in evening light. Best light in the whole set.

east-cape-04.note: East Cape Road with a lone tree. An empty road is the single most on-brand image available to a touring company.

forest-03.note: Te Urewera trail. Cluttered but authentic.

forest-04.note: A person at a kauri dieback boot-wash station. Identifiable individual, no model release, and mundane.

coast-01.note: Pakiri Beach. Public domain, so no attribution obligation.

coast-02.note: ISS satellite photograph. Public domain and beautiful, but it is not a place a guest stands.

coast-04.note: A grid of 2023 general election candidate headshots. Every automated gate passed it. This single file is the argument for the visual gate existing.

geothermal-01.note: Algal mats, Orakei Korako. This ochre is the sulphur accent token.

geothermal-02.note: Algal mats, stronger composition. Best geothermal colour in the set.

geothermal-04.note: Craters of the Moon. Steam over scrub, sun behind.

waitomo-11.note: Duplicate of waitomo-05 (same Ruakuri file, re-fetched by the top-up run).

auckland-12.note: Titled for the kelp, but the frame is a wave breaking through a rock gap on the west coast. Dramatic and on-brand despite the misleading title.

auckland-13.note: Monochrome wave at the Gap. Striking; use sparingly so the set does not read as half black-and-white.

auckland-14.note: Ice plant on Muriwai black sand. Ignore the botany - this is the best photograph of west-coast black sand in the set, and black sand is the basalt token.

coast-11.note: Hokianga Harbour with the road in frame and the north-head dunes beyond. Road plus destination - the strongest touring image in the whole library.

coast-12.note: Hokianga panorama, 7000x2190. Only usable as a full-width band; it will not crop to a card.

coast-15.note: Whangarei Heads from the water. Wake in the foreground gives it motion.
